verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV documents a server-side API (e.g. /identity_verification/retry) and a Sandbox mode that accepts a fixed set of test inputs and custom test users, which supports some automated, non-production testing. The core verification flow, however, runs through the user-facing Link UI, and nothing documents running the full flow headlessly or in CI pipelines. Missing for 10: documented headless or no-UI execution of the verification flow, CI integration guidance or tooling, programmatic session creation without Link, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: In Sandbox mode, Identity Verification accepts the fixed set of inputs below in order to result in successful Data Source and Documentary Verification checks.
Plaid supports creating custom test users from your organization directly in Sandbox.
/identity_verification/retry | Allow a user to retry an identity verification
